eagles.name: Geoff Dziena
eagles.project: Umbrella Stands at the Energy & Marine Center. Port Richey, Florida

paragraphs: Geoff Dziena's Eagle Project was to plan and install umbrella stands at the Energy and Marine Center. Students visit the EMC throughout the year. There are work tables outside where they can touch and feel different items, but these stands have no shade. These new stands will allow the EMC to put out umbrellas when needed to keep the students out of the sun.

eagles.name: Henry Koljeski
eagles.project: Aquaponics Tank at the Energy & Marine Center. Port Richey, Florida

paragraphs: Henry Koljeski's Eagle Project was to plan and install an aquaponics tank at the Energy Marine Center (EMC). This tank will help teach the thousands of students who visit the EMC every year how plants filter the water, the filtered water falls into the tank oxygenating it, and the fish waste fertilizes and is used by the plants to grow.

eagles.name: Noah Ealy
eagles.project: Educational Signage at the Energy & Marine Center. Port Richey, Florida

paragraphs: Noah Ealy's Eagle Project was to plan and install educational signage at the Energy Marine Center (EMC). These signs will allow the thousands of students who visit the EMC every year to easily and quickly be able to identify the wildlife they see.

eagles.name: Jack Vann
eagles.project: Barbecue Grill Station at Trinity Presbyterian Church of Seven Springs

paragraphs: Jack Vann's Eagle Project was a barbecue grill station that was completed in February of 2011. This project will benefit the Trinity Presbyterian Church of Seven Springs and the different worship and youth groups that are associated with the church. This barbecue grill will provide an area for the church members to cook food such as hot dogs and hamburgers for different events that are held throughout the year. With the implementation of this project, it will eliminate the need for a parishioner to transport his or her own personal grill to and from these events. It will also eliminate the need for a storage shelter for a propane grill if someone donated one. Its location will also provide easy access for the cooks and workers in the kitchen of the Founder's Hall. The estimated cost of this project is $1,800.

eagles.name: Jason Brown
eagles.project: Plan and install new playground equipment, along with a new fence around the playground, and 100 cubic yards of playground mulch to benefit the Children's Ministry of Trinity Presbyterian Church of Seven Springs

paragraphs: Jason Brown's Eagle Project was to plan and install new playground equipment, along with a new fence around the playground, and 100 cubic yards of playground mulch to benefit the Children's Ministry of the church at an approximate cost of $11,000. It is envisioned that future Eagle Projects can add additional playground equipment to build a wonderful playground for the children of the church.

eagles.name: Jeffrey Motley
eagles.project: Plan and install a "Walk of Faith" Memorial Brick Pathway for the Trinity Presbyterian Church of Seven Springs

paragraphs: Jeffrey Motley's Eagle Project was to plan and install a "Walk of Faith" Memorial Brick Pathway for the Trinity Presbyterian Church of Seven Springs at an approximate cost of $3,000. This project will provide a permanent memorial for church members, as well as serve as an on-going, long-term fundraising opportunity for the church, to include future Eagle Projects.
